## Analyzer Architecture Summary

- feast is a Kubernetes component.
- deploying 3 workload(s) (controller-manager, controller-manager, controller-manager) with 3 container(s).
- watching 13 resource type(s).
- exposing 1 service(s) on ports\: 6566.
- Dockerfile EXPOSE ports\: 3000, 8000, 8080.
- connecting to external services\: azure-blob, elasticsearch, gcs, grpc, httpx, milvus, mlflow, mongodb, mysql, pinecone, postgres, qdrant, redis, requests, s3, sqlalchemy, sqlite, urllib, weaviate.
- runtime dependencies\: HashiCorp Vault, MLflow, MongoDB, OpenTelemetry Collector, PostgreSQL, S3.
- 29 Python package dependencies (29 required), categories\: 1 data, 1 database, 1 numerical, 1 observability, 1 web-server, 2 serialization, 2 web-framework.
- with 407 operator config constants (6 image references, 11 env vars).
- exposing 1 Prometheus metrics.
- Python k8s client with 255 API call(s).
- integrates with management relationship via labels/annotations.
- deploys kube-rbac-proxy sidecar for RBAC-based authorization.
- references components\: mlflow (import).
